Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Self Transition Mode
Fields.Description: What happens when the transition goes from a state to itself: continue if the generator is cyclic and blend if not, continue, reset, or blend.

Fields.Name: Event Mode
Fields.Description: Which generators receive events during the transition: the default (from the project data), both (process all), or all but the from generator or the to generator.

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: How long the blend from the old generator to the new one takes, in seconds.

Fields.Name: To Generator Start Time Fraction
Fields.Description: Where in its playback the target generator starts, as a fraction of its duration (0 is the start).

Fields.Name: Blend Flags
Fields.Description: Blend options: ignore the from generator's root motion, sync the two generators, ignore the to generator's root motion (or only its rotation), don't blend controls data.

Fields.Name: End Mode
Fields.Description: How the blend ends: after its duration, at the end of the from generator, or after its duration but no later than the end of the from generator.

Fields.Name: Blend Curve
Fields.Description: The shape of the blend over its duration: smooth, linear, ease in or ease out.

Fields.Name: Alignment Bone
Fields.Description: A bone the two poses are aligned on during the blend. -1 for none.
